No sampler-exhaustion, NTT microbenchmark, sanitizer, tail-batch, or full public-API qualification is claimed.
Default module provenance remains unsealed; recorded artifacts are experimental builds.
SM120 experimental architecture port, not the original SM89 binary.
No public Engine qualification, performance comparison or full FIPS certification is implied.
ML-DSA-87 KeyGen, Sign and Verify alone use --Ofast-compile=min; cross-GPU timing must disclose this compiler difference.
